__comment: PLANE OCCLUSION, part 1 of 2. A sphere with an infinite Plane between it and the point light above. The plane must block the light, leaving the sphere unlit. Must match quad_shadow, which is the same scene with the Plane replaced by a large quad mesh. Planes live outside the BVH, so if shadow queries only consult the BVH the sphere here is lit while the quad version is dark. The camera is framed so the occluder itself is barely in view, keeping the comparison about the shadow.
